summary: 75-year-old John Miketin, who had dementia, walked away from his home on North Surrey Court in the Redlands on Jan 11, 2024; multi-day search by MCSO deputies, Mesa County SAR volunteers, community members, drones and CDPS aircraft; found deceased Jan 19, 2024 near the 2000 block of E 1/2 Road on private property; death not considered suspicious.
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue; Grand Junction Fire Department; Colorado Department of Public Safety (aircraft); Center of Excellence for Advanced Technology Aerial Firefighting (Rifle)
notes: Dementia-related walk-away; date shown is the date he was found deceased (last seen Jan 11, 2024).
